paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 74a: Resh Lakish said that R' Samya said; Hyman suggests that the reading should be Rabbi Simai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yevamot 74a reads Resh Lakish reporting Rabbi Simai (סימאי), the form Hyman proposes for the supplied Samya (סמיא).

The actual Davidson Yevamot 74a paragraph has Resh Lakish reporting Rabbi Simai. The supplied Samya spelling is retained separately from Hyman’s proposed Simai. The new Samya heading and occurrence deliberately retain R', while full Rabbi Simai is locally supported by the named paragraph. The existing note remains verbatim; no alias or identity harmonization is admitted.
